translations.web: You shall not plow with an ox and a donkey together.
translations.bsb: Do not plow with an ox and a donkey yoked together.
translations.kjv: Thou shalt not plow with an ox and an ass together.
translations.asv: Thou shalt not plow with an ox and an ass together.
